_comment: camper_role (custom prop set by build_scene.py) -> SCS Blender Tools shader preset. Preset names must exist in the add-on's shader_presets.txt (tools/scs_addon_src/io_scs_tools/shader_presets.txt, 2.4.1). Textures are tiny original placeholders generated by scripts/make_textures.py into texture_source_dir and copied next to the exported model. Roles with reflection_file get an original placeholder reflection texture inside the model dir, because the add-on drops references to textures that do not exist in the SCS project (the game's /material/environment/vehicle_reflection is not available here and must never be shipped).

body_paint._status: UNVERIFIED: preset 'truckpaint' (Effect eut2.truckpaint, shader_presets.txt line 1569) is the add-on's truck-paint effect. Whether Road Trip F-150 accessories get body colour via this effect, via the COLORMASK/AIRBRUSH flavors (aux[5..8] paintjob colours) or via the PAINT flavor on dif.* effects is NOT yet checked in-game. Base preset only (no flavors) until that mechanism check is done.

glass._status: Standard 'glass' preset (eut2.glass, line 1237); base texture overridden with original placeholder, reflection texture keeps the add-on default game path reference (no asset shipped).

lamp._status: Third brake light lens. Placeholder 'dif.spec' red until the game's lamp/light effect is checked (the 'lamp' preset needs game light masks).

not_applicable_extensions..pic: collision locators not authored yet (V1 gate)
not_applicable_extensions..pmd/.pmg: produced by SCS Conversion Tools, not this add-on
